items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: I had a guy by the name of Joe Cherniowski, who was at Columbia Pictures.

ctx.x: But we had, Joe Cherniowski was there. Joseph Cherniowski. He was, he was, uh, Paramount Publix personality leader. He was at the Sanger Theater for a while. Incidentally, and, and he was with Paramount Publix, which he was, he went, in fact, I went to Chicago and put a card in for Chicago to, to, to work with Joe, but, um, I found out that, uh, there was a couple of gangsters up there that, uh, would have taken care of me if I would have gone to work with Joe. And, uh, Joe was at the Chicago Theater. But he, he…
